title: Quel'Delar Restored
summary: A lost blade's hilt leads through identification, reforging, purification, and a contested return at the Sunwell.
opening: A broken remnant can carry a people's memory. The Quel'Delar questline asks who may restore that memory and who may claim the blade afterward.
reviewNote: Capture original Wrath quest text and faction-specific endings before treating the outline as a settled account.
